verdict.rationale: Draft A misattributes the FY2021 margin trough to the Mountain Valley Pipeline impairment. Its own source [10] puts that charge in 2020 and says it was absent in 2021. A also says the capital programme drives operating cash flow, and adds dividend-pressure speculation. Both drafts cite an $89m figure their passage does not state. A offers more depth (NEER capacity, FY2023 hedge gains, restatement caveat). B is better supported and labels its judgements as analysis.

verdict.rationale: Both drafts wrongly tie the FY2021 margin trough to the FY2020 Mountain Valley Pipeline impairment. A also misreads the +23.5pp figure, which is the change from FY2022, not FY2021. B supports the FY2023 peak with the hedge-gain passage and adds NEER capacity additions, the decline in FPL's revenue share, debt versus equity compounding and a restatement caveat. B's watch items overreach on the dividend and hedge-driven claims, while A labels its analysis well.
